X_test_raw = test_df[final_feature_cols].copy()

def encode_categorical(df, col, le_dict):
    def safe_encode(x):
        if pd.isna(x) or x == "" or x is None:
            return 0
        if isinstance(x, list):
            # Convert list to space-separated string
            x = (
                " ".join(str(s) for s in x[:5])
                if len(x) > 5
                else " ".join(str(s) for s in x)
            )
        current_str = str(x)
        if current_str not in le_dict:
            try:
                le = LabelEncoder()
                le.fit([current_str] if not pd.isna(x) else ["empty"])
                le_dict[col] = le
            except:
                le_dict[col] = LabelEncoder()
                le_dict[col].fit(["empty"])
        return le_dict[col].transform([current_str])[0] if not pd.isna(x) else 0

    return df.applymap(safe_encode, col=col)
